lessons.title: Linear Equations & Graphing
lessons.objective: Understand that the graph of an equation in two variables is the set of all its solutions plotted in the coordinate plane.

lessons.title: Quadratic Formula & Factoring
lessons.objective: Solve quadratic equations in one variable using inspection, square roots, and the quadratic formula.

lessons.title: The Pythagorean Theorem
lessons.objective: Use trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean Theorem to solve right triangles in applied problems.

lessons.title: Coordinate Plane Transformations
lessons.objective: Represent transformations in the plane using transparencies and geometry software; describe transformations as functions.

lessons.title: Interpreting Data Distributions
lessons.objective: Represent data with plots on the real number line, including dot plots, histograms, and box plots.

lessons.title: Independent & Conditional Probability
lessons.objective: Understand that two events A and B are independent if the probability of both occurring together is the product of their probabilities.

lessons.title: Limits & Continuity
lessons.objective: Determine the limit of a function using numerical, graphical, and algebraic evaluation methods.

lessons.title: The Derivative Concept
lessons.objective: Define the derivative of a function as a limit of a difference quotient and interpret it as an instantaneous rate of change.
